_comment: Every key below maps to a REAL field on an already-existing, frozen
engine config dataclass -- traced from phantom/*/config.py, not
invented. Copy this file to phantom_config.json (same folder as
install.py/start.py) and edit before running install.py, or just run
install.py directly -- it copies this file for you automatically.
Paths in this file are RELATIVE to this config file's own folder by
default, so Phantom can be installed anywhere and still find its own
SECRETS: never put a real API key directly in this file if you can
avoid it. Set bridge.api_key_env_var to the name of an environment
variable, set that environment variable on the machine (or let
install.py generate one for you), and Phantom reads the real value
at startup -- never from this file, never logged.

runtime._note: magic_number MUST match bridge.magic_number -- both are read by the same MT5 EA instance and must agree, or the EA will reject commands as a magic-number mismatch.

trading_profile._note: selected_profile must be exactly one of the 6 factory names below, or "custom" (custom requires editing start.py's build_custom_profile() directly -- a config file alone can't express an explicit allowed_pairs/allowed_strategies list). Session windows and strategy eligibility are governed by the selected profile itself (phantom/runtime/profiles.py) and by phantom/strategy_engine/config.py -- not independently overridable from this file.

risk._maps_to: phantom.risk_engine.config.RiskEngineConfig (partial -- the fields most operators tune; every other field keeps its engine default unless you edit start.py's RiskEngineConfig(...) call)

compliance._maps_to: phantom.compliance_engine.config.ComplianceEngineConfig / ComplianceRuleProfile (by name -- must be a name registered in ComplianceEngineConfig.rule_profiles)
compliance._note: "example_generic_profile" is the shipped illustrative default, not a real prop-firm's actual rules -- replace with your firm's real profile before going live.

news._note: The Market Intelligence Engine has exactly ONE trust signal for its whole news feed -- news_feed_trusted below. There is NO per-provider concept anywhere in that engine today: no Trading Economics primary / Forex Factory backup failover, no provider-disagreement detection (confirmed by grep -- zero references to either provider name anywhere in phantom/market_intelligence/). See news_providers below and KNOWN_GAPS.md. What DOES exist and IS fail-closed today: if you cannot vouch for your news feed, set news_feed_trusted to false and the engine assumes the worst (blackout, score=0) rather than silently treating an untrustworthy feed as safe.

news_providers._note: RESERVED for phantom/news_ingestion/ (ADR-033 Part 2), which does NOT exist in this repository yet -- these keys are parsed and validated so the config format is ready, but nothing currently reads or acts on them. Trading Economics is the intended primary provider, Forex Factory the automatic backup, per ADR-033's design -- once that package is built. Until then, news.news_feed_trusted above is the only real, working news-trust control.

logging._note: Consumed by start.py itself (not an engine config field -- the engines all log through Python's stdlib logging module and do not know about file paths themselves; start.py attaches the handlers described here before constructing any engine). Relative paths (the default) are resolved against this config file's own folder.
